row: Scotty's Animals channel is about animal rescue. I am an animal rescue volunteer in Los Angeles. I volunteer at the Los Angeles Guinea Pig Rescue.  My channel aims to help people care for animals. https://www.scottysanimals.com I have been volunteering with different animal rescues in California for a number of years now. Rescues like: The Feral Cat Foundation, Reptile and Amphibian Rescue Network, Wee Companions, Orange County Cavy Haven, Rabbit Rescue Inc, Los Angeles Guinea Pig Rescue, and others.  Caring for animals requires adult supervision. This information is intended for adults. Only adults can make the decision about adopting animals, and taking home new pets.
